_about: Pass/fail thresholds for stage 10, written 2026-11-28 before run.py was first executed. Each check compares one key of results/<id>.json 'metrics' with max (value <= x), min (value >= x) or equals. A run 'succeeds' when Nav2 returns SUCCEEDED and the true final position is within final_error_m of the goal. Thresholds are not loosened to make a task pass; a changed threshold keeps its old value and the reason under 'changes'.

_common.basis: final error: Nav2 stops when AMCL's estimate is inside xy_goal_tolerance 0.25 m, and AMCL was 0.08-0.19 m off in the arena runs (README), so 0.5 m. Clearance: distance from the true base centre to the nearest obstacle surface; the body half-width is 0.15 m, 0.10 m margin on top. It rules out side contact, not a corner of the 0.65 m long body clipping an edge.

10.01.title: A to B in an empty room

10.04.title: Through a narrow passage
10.04.basis: 1.0 m wide, 1.6 m long passage; footprint diameter 0.66 m

10.08.title: Replan when the path is blocked
10.08.basis: box 0.3 x 1.6 x 0.8 m spawned on the plan 1.5 m ahead of the robot; at 0.25 m/s the robot needs 6 s to reach it, so a plan around it within 3 s leaves 0.75 m

10.09.title: Reject an unreachable goal
10.09.basis: two goals: the centre of the 1 m box and (8, 8), outside the map. Status 6 = ABORTED. The default tree runs its recoveries before it gives up (p13: 16.4 s, a 0.30 m back-up), hence 0.6 m

10.10.title: Cancel a goal
10.10.basis: cancel after 0.8 m of walking; 0.25 m/s braked at the velocity smoother's 0.8 m/s^2 takes 0.3 s, plus the gait settling; three cancels on one stack

10.11.title: Manual override
10.11.basis: project 11's twist_mux chain re-run unchanged: teleop priority 100 over Nav2 10; 500 ms is twist_mux's Nav2 timeout, 2.0 s covers the 0.6 s teleop timeout plus one controller cycle

10.12.title: Follow waypoints
10.12.basis: three waypoints (-4.5, -0.8), (-0.4, -3.8), B; no waypoint missed

10.13.title: Patrol
10.13.basis: project 13's patrol tree re-run unchanged: A, W1, W2, A, twice

10.14.title: Go and return
10.14.basis: a run succeeds when both legs (A to B, B to A) succeed

10.15.title: Repeat in a modified environment
10.15.basis: the 10.03 task on obstacles.yaml while the world has one obstacle added and two moved
